time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0; frame for time t = round(t*fps)
units: pixels and seconds; image x right, y down; no metric scale assumed
probable_orientation: Footage appears rotated 90 deg: the free-flying packet accelerates uniformly toward +x (per-frame dx grows ~21->162 px over frames 52-65), so image +x is most likely physical DOWN (gravity) and the black strip + wood at right is the floor/ground side. Image y is then a horizontal direction. This is an interpretation, not a measurement.

objects.name: packet
objects.description: small square pink/red foil sachet with white Japanese text (the only pink object)

size_px_at_rest.note: square ~99-100 px side, lying flat in image plane on the black strip; best size reference

size_px_in_hand.note: partly hidden by fingers at the left image edge; mask/bbox unreliable for size

objects.name: hand
objects.description: person's hand (skin) at left image edge holding the packet, frames 0-~58; arm/hand re-enters from lower left moving toward lower centre frames ~97-109

objects.name: black_strip
objects.description: vertical black band (baseboard / floor edge) right of the grey wall
objects.tilt: edges lean ~15 px right over 1080 rows (~0.8 deg)

objects.name: wood_surface
objects.description: light-brown wooden planks right of the black strip (likely floor)
objects.frame0_extent_x: from black strip right edge (~1460-1478) to image right edge 1919, visible width ~442-460 px; full height

objects.name: grey_wall
objects.description: plain light grey surface occupying x 0-~1326; faint dark specks; soft grey shadows of the person in lower-left/lower part

events.name: release / start of free motion
events.note: first frame packet moves away from hand (cx 75->92); +-1 frame

events.name: first contact with black strip (impact)
events.note: frame 64 right edge x~1201 well left of strip (~1318); frame 65 right edge ~1367 overlaps strip; contact occurs between 64 and 65

events.name: comes to rest
events.note: after this only camera drift (packet cx 1383->1367, cy 969->963 by f109)

camera.motion: handheld slow drift, smooth, no shake: background moves ~-26 to -28 px in x and ~-12 to -14 px in y between frame 0 and 109 (about -0.25 px/frame in x)
camera.note: strip_dx/dy (phase correlation on strip+wood, rows 0-420) and wall_dx/dy (high-passed wall texture) agree within ~2-3 px; wood_* columns invalid after frame 37 (resp<0.05). Black strip left edge moved -26 px (top) / -30 px (bottom) by f109, so a tiny rotation/zoom is present.
